provenance.basis: User states the vehicle matches Mazda2 specifications; March 2020 DJ manufacturer dimensions are the working baseline for both 2020 Fuji sessions.
provenance.tyres: 185 mm is the nominal section width of the 185/65R15 and 185/60R16 standard options in the March 2020 specification. 195/55R16 is another listed option. This is not a measured loaded contact patch or confirmed 2020 racing tyre fitment.
provenance.scope: Only the matching vehicle/laps explicitly carrying this geometry in gps_registration.json use these dimensions.
provenance.limitations: The March 2020 manufacturer specification does not establish this vehicle's exact grade, wheel offset, installed tyres, or antenna position. Rendered body styling remains a generic proxy.
